description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, causes [DEF, RES and MND -70%] for 8 seconds, grants [Attach Fire 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Earth 2 with Stacking] to the user if the entry damage was Fire/Earth, [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Krile (Fire, Earth)] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Krile (Fire, Earth)
description.text: Increases [Fire/Earth Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for BLK, WHT, BLU, SUM or NAT attacks that deal magical damage, Fire or Earth abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Krile after using two Fire or Earth abilities (max 3), removed if the character hasn’t Zenith Mode

description.name: Cleansing+
description.text: Four single attacks (3.75 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Kindred Flame+
description.text: Five single attacks (5.25 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Spirit Attack: Krile
description.text: Causes [DEF, RES and MND -50% (8s)] to the target, grants [Buff Fire 10% (5s)] and [Buff Earth 10% (5s)] to all allies

description.name: Attach Fire 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Attach Earth 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
